description: This file defines the class Image_Graph_Plot_Band, which is a PHP class for rendering a band (area chart with min and max) in a graph plotting library. It includes methods for drawing legend samples and rendering the plot with upper and lower bands based on dataset values.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Band
classes.description: A class for rendering band (area with min and max) charts in a graph plotting library.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample representation of the band in the legend.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the band plot, constructing upper and lower bands from dataset and drawing polygons.
